title: On a Keller-Segel type equation to model Brain Microvascular Endothelial Cells growth's patterns
summary: This article presents a partial differential equation (PDE) of Keller-Segel (KS) type that reproduces patterns commonly observed during the growth of brain microvasculature. We provide mathematical insights into the mechanisms underlying the emergence of these patterns. In addition, we derive a data-driven equation that ensures a consistent temporal evolution of the chemoattractant associated with the observed microvascular dynamics.
